name: Chasing You 2
source:
A young aristocrat must solve the mystery of a death at a ball by delving into the dark side of Victorian London. In return, they will find great friendships and unforgettable love.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Chasing_You_2]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
一位年轻贵族必须深入了解维多利亚时代伦敦的黑暗面，解开舞会上的死亡之谜。作为回报，他们会找到伟大的友谊和难忘的爱情。

来自 [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Chasing_You_2]romance-club.fandom[/url]
